subject: tf-sh
title: (R)TF.SH.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Diagram in WAC-20, the page where Braxton discusses the cross-transfer dynamics of western extension in the early 1900s. (R)TF-SH — the *reality* of transfer shift — is crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle): the question is what real transfer shift looks like when crossed with the world-expansion principle. Two branches leave the main line. ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) → EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) → INFO-DE (information degrees), with INFO-DE branching to MTH (methodology) and to IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) → AFL (affinity alignment) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance).
